scope: Battle of Snowblind Mesa (38915) and Battle Worms (39776): native quest objectives, Mayla availability, ordinary kill credit and worm spell execution. Code/data work only, as requested by the user.
native_evidence: highmountain-battle-worms-native-2026-10-12.json; regenerated and compared by Test-HighmountainBattleWormsNative.py against TDB735 and the canonical runtime DB2 files.

repairs.problem: Local objective 280011 described following Mayla but had Amount=0. The February 2018 TDB735 quest has no numeric objectives and instructs the player to travel to Snowblind Mesa and speak with Mayla.
repairs.change: Remove only the exact known placeholder, guarded by quest, objective type, storage, object, amount, flags and description. A custom replacement with different data is preserved. No escort, synthetic arrival credit or automatic reward is added.
repairs.limitation: The zero-amount row was a data/UI mismatch, not proof that the journey could not be completed. December 2015 alpha footage describes marching with Mayla; it does not override the later version-specific objective records.

repairs.problem: Arxas has Hooked Tongue in its existing combat catalog, but its script effect had no dummy link, spell script or spell_scripts handler. Native effect 0 encodes child 197253, whose JUMP_DEST effect moves its caster to the target's front.
repairs.change: Add a HIT_TARGET/effect-0 dummy link using option 11, caster selector 5 (hit target), target selector 3 (original caster). The struck unit casts native 197253 toward Arxas. No custom jump speed, damage, position or spell ID is invented.
repairs.handler_evidence: Spell::SpellDummyTriggered option 11 honors triggerCaster/triggerTarget and checks both for null. Option 6 directly uses m_caster/unitTarget and would reverse this movement; compiled production-handler tests caught that distinction before deployment.

retained_findings.naxa: No Naxa AI change. Native 197232 uses DurationIndex 21, Duration=-1, making it AICOND_AGGRO. AggressorAI::EnterCombat casts that branch directly on who. Although FillAISpellInfo classifies its target-25 effects as SELF, the ordinary combat-loop DoCast target selection is not the entry path for this permanent aura. A self-cast defect was not established.
retained_findings.objectives: 39776 retains 279939 -> Xist 97013, 280504 -> Naxa 99217, 280505 -> Arxas 99216. Each requires one kill, with native flag 1 and distinct storage indices 0/1/2.
retained_findings.actors: All three existing worm spawns are unphased on map 1220 and have active scaling 98..110. Mayla 93846 spawn 11351491 is unphased and ends both quests; the additional phase-9180 copy was not changed.
retained_findings.starter_phase: 38915 starts at Mayla 108434, including Thunder Totem spawn 11348959 in phase 2246. Existing zone 7731 phase entry 3 requires quest 39580 rewarded. Skyhorn reward alone therefore does not establish that this starter is visible. This prerequisite/phase relationship was documented and preserved; no unsupported shortcut was added.
retained_findings.handoff: Native RewardNextQuest is 39776 for 38915 and 42088 for 39776. Local addon links also lead from 39776 to 39777. The parallel quests and later evacuation gate need their own audit; this batch does not rewrite those prerequisites.

All six kill orders and all eight subsets require three distinct worms; repeated, unrelated, absent/rewarded and raid kills do not bypass the objectives. The journey has no numeric kill requirement and must be rewarded before the next quest.
git diff --check passes. Existing compiler fixture warnings remain; no production C++ was changed.

deployment.method: Scoped mysqldump backups; stopped worldserver; InnoDB transaction with RELEASED updater registration; post-apply read-only live test.
deployment.runtime: build-extractors/bin/Release. SQL-only repair; no executable rebuild or replacement required. Server remains stopped, so runtime caches will load the changes on next startup. Character progress was not edited.
